items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: Justin Adams, Delton Russo, Charlie Burbank, Larry Marino... we had a lot of fun... we were perfect friends.

ctx.x: What was your favorite band? Which band are you talking about?

The Untouchables, number one and two. Okay, and that's. That's the one that's on. Yeah, we were talking about that on. Right. See, that was a real band. Justin Adams. Justin Adams, Delton Russo, Charlie Burbank, Larry Marino. See, what it was, these were musicians who was able to read. They can adjust. We never had no music problem. You see, last night I was rehearsing and it left a whole lot to be desired. And I felt kind of bad. You feel like. Yeah, but it makes my, yeah, I'm not being.
You're not giving your best effort.
